card.name: Small words inside set phrases
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as this, on, in, every or to, inside older general prose, where they sit mid-phrase before a noun like field, area, respect or map. The setting is non-medical text, with one dosage-label case.

modes.label: Demonstrative before place noun
modes.description: The word this after a preposition, pointing at a field or area just mentioned.
modes.example: Among works performed in<< this>> field are the creation of a theoretical basis

modes.label: Words inside fixed expressions
modes.description: A preposition or modifier within an idiom such as put it on the map or in every respect.

modes.description: A word-part or modifier inside a noun phrase, such as Liquor Control or sexual instinct.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are a mixed set of Chinese and English words, and the suppressed ones are about perception and awareness, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words in the middle of ordinary phrases in old-style prose, not on any medical idea.
